name: OUR FIRST DATE
source:
Luke. Same campus, a few classes together.
The kind of conversations that always end too soon, because one of you has somewhere else to be.

Lately, you've been talking more than usual.

It's just a drink. Just one evening.
Answer his questions. Tell him a little about yourself.
He's a good listener.

[b][i]He'll remember what you like.[/i][/b]
